speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome. The patient's presentation of aggressive behavior, altered mental status, autonomic dysregulation (diaphoresis), and recent high-intensity exercise combined with exam stress strongly suggests a serotonergic toxicity crisis. While the untrusted input mentions no fever, the clinical picture of agitation and autonomic instability is classic for this condition.
